thread:
emily: Promo code `REDWOODSPRING24` is being rejected as "expired" when I try to apply it on the billing page. It should be valid through 2026-05-31. Account email: emily+work@gmail.com. Screenshot attached.

alex_support: Hey emily — sorry for the trouble. Can you DM the screenshot and your account id? Quick troubleshooting while I look: try copying the code into a plain text editor to remove invisible chars and try in incognito. Also which region/currency are you on?

emily: Sent screenshot and account id (123456). I'm on EU/EUR. Tried incognito, same result. No extra spaces when I paste.

alex_support: Got it. Checking redemption logs and promo metadata now.

alex_support: Running quick query:
```
SELECT code, expires_at, status, metadata_updated_at
FROM promo_catalog
WHERE code = 'REDWOODSPRING24';
```

-- result: code REDWOODSPRING24 | expires_at = 2026-05-25T23:59:59Z | status = active | metadata_updated_at = 2026-02-10T08:12:03Z

alex_support: Huh — marketing extended the promo to 2026-05-31 last week, but our checkout edge nodes appear to be serving an older cached version that lists expiry 2026-05-25. Looks like an edge cache staleness issue rather than the user's input.

alex_support: I'm going to purge the promo cache for the code and request a manual credit while we fix the cache invalidation flow. Executing: `cachectl purge promo:REDWOODSPRING24`

alex_support: `cachectl` output: promo:REDWOODSPRING24 purge request queued -> success on edge node eu-1.

maria_billing: I can apply a manual credit while eng sorts the cache. Confirming amount — promo is $50 credit, correct?

emily: Yes, $50. Thank you.

maria_billing: Applying manual credit now to account 123456. Will post confirmation.

maria_billing: Manual credit +$50 applied to account 123456. Reference: BILL-INV-2026-4342.

billing-bot: credit_applied | account=123456 | amount=50.00 USD | tx=tx_8a7f2b | by=maria_billing

tom_eng: FYI eng looked into this: promo updates didn't trigger a CDN invalidation in the promo-service for codes updated via the marketing UI. TTL on promo metadata cached at the edge was 24h; marketing extended the code but the UI update path didn't call the purge API. We'll land a fix to ensure purge on update and add a realtime invalidation hook.

tom_eng: Patch will roll out to staging this afternoon, production in the next deploy window.

emily: I can confirm the billing page now accepts the code and I see the $50 credit applied. Code works when I try to redeem again. Thank you everyone! :raised_hands: :heart:

alex_support: Glad it's sorted. Leaving a note on the support ticket to document the root cause (edge cache stale after manual extension) and that billing granted a manual credit. We'll follow up when the fix is deployed.

emily: Appreciate the quick help.

alex_support: Closing the loop — ticket #SUP-2026-7782 updated, tag `promo-cache-stale`, will follow up once CDN invalidation patch is live.

maria_billing: If anyone else hits this, manual credit flow is `billing:apply_credit account=<id> amount=<amt> reason="promo cache stale"` — saves time.

emily: Thanks again!
